_comment: Course-wide snapshot years shared by every stage. fetch-base.mjs fills source_year and gap from historical-basemaps index.json using `rule` (nearest-not-after: latest base map not later than the calendar year; or nearest). A snapshot may pin a base year with source_override. The cartouche shows calendar year · base map source_year when they differ. A snapshot with "stages" belongs only to those stages and their variants ("world" also covers world-atlantic, world-americas); the rest are shared by every stage.
_suggested: The world page's suggested years (owner, 2026-11-09: any year can be typed, and every stage draws Cliopatria's states in force that year): the year buttons, the dots on the timeline strip, and the steps of the arrow keys and Play, the same on every stage. The course years, the Unit 3 and 4 years, and 1250, 1300 and 1400 for the owner's 1250-1750 maps. The `snapshots` below stay for the historical-basemaps derivation (scripts/derive.mjs) and the admin page; the world page no longer draws them.

snapshots.override_reason: The 1400 map still shows the Mongol Great Khanate over China and has no Moscow; 1492 shows the Ming Empire and the Grand Duchy of Moscow. Trade-off: 1492 already shows Constantinople as Ottoman (fell 1453).

snapshots.stages_reason: Added 2026-11-06 for the world stage (Unit 4 voyages: 1530 for Magellan-Elcano, 1650 for the mid-century galleon and Atlantic maps). Not on the Afro-Eurasia stage until the owner decides.

Added 2026-11-06 for the world stage (Unit 4 voyages: 1530 for Magellan-Elcano, 1650 for the mid-century galleon and Atlantic maps). Not on the Afro-Eurasia stage until the owner decides. On the Europe stage from 2026-11-09: just after the Peace of Westphalia, at the start of Louis XIV's reign.

Added 2026-11-09 for the Europe stage (absolutism; Louis XIV died on 1 September 1715). historical-basemaps' 1715 map draws Brandenburg under Prussia and the Habsburg lands as one state; its 1700 map folds both into the Holy Roman Empire.
